description: README lists WordPress as planned and not implemented, but the repo already carries WP-CLI support through RemoteCli, runtime detection, a large workspace component, hardening and cron actions, snapshots and extensive feature tests. What is actually missing is a standalone managed product surface. Inventory the existing VM WordPress capability, then define the boundary: tenancy, infrastructure model, provisioning, billing, routing, migration and what gets reused. File implementation epics only after that decision lands.
title: ADR: standalone managed WordPress surface
